inspection_method: view_image detail=original for the main Rerun screenshot, decision PNG, and supplementary exact-summary screenshot

visual_notes: The main 4800x2800 screenshot shows four link5 panels and four gripper panels. Source is white, live instance blue, prototype magenta, and candidate green.

Raw and live clear-separation endpoint/vector labels are present for link5 and gripper. The target cylinder and target/commanded/actual frame markers are visible; the decision PNG makes their overlay especially clear.
Viewer loading notices cover part of the upper-right corner, but the candidate geometry and all decision subjects remain materially visible.

The embedded collision blueprint did not put the four static summary rows in the visible event-table viewport. Their exact presence was verified from the main RRD chunks, then a non-authoritative text-only RRD rendered those same strings and source hashes legibly.
The decision PNG title reports link5 raw/cook +4.273/+4.273 mm and gripper raw/cook +11.175/+11.340 mm; both clear-witness pairs and all three TCP markers are legible.
bounded_interpretation: Rerun spatial geometry and the supplementary summary are Float32/display copies and never numerical or hash authority.
The authority values remain the original Float64 measurement JSON and immutable D347/D348 callback-topology evidence.
The live value is a D347 callback-face surface proxy, not a direct PhysX narrowphase distance API result.
This inspection supports only the zero-step frozen OPEN target-distance case; it does not support settle, grasp, G0a, G0b, RL, or ladder promotion.
